title: yliveticker · Yahoo Finance
description: Live Yahoo Finance ticks from an east-to-west global watchlist are stored in InfluxDB 2 (ticker_data). SYNTH-* prices appear only in the explicit synthetic test feed.

options.content:
**Live Yahoo Finance feed · east-to-west watchlist · [InfluxDB](http://localhost:8086) bucket `ticker_data`.**

Charts use your browser timezone (`${__timezone}`); switch the time picker to UTC whenever preferred. Info bubbles give regular sessions directly in UTC, with both daylight- and standard-time hours where DST applies. Empty price charts intentionally keep sleeping markets visible; unavailable volume charts are omitted. Holidays, special sessions, DST and Yahoo delays can change coverage. `SYNTH-*` is CI-only. [Details](https://github.com/yahoofinancelive/yliveticker/blob/feat/pooling-and-grafana/docker/README.md).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "ticker_data")
  |> range(start: -30s)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ticker" and r._field == "price")
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 1)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: if r.id =~ /^SYNTH-/ then 1 else 0}))

panels.title: Stored ticks (selected range)
panels.description: Price records read from InfluxDB; count excludes volume fields. Zero means no ticks have reached storage in this time range.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "ticker_data")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ticker" and r._field == "price")
  |> group()
  |> count()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _time: now(), _field: "stored_ticks"}))

panels.title: Received ticks/min (last 60s)
panels.description: Ticks received by the collector during the latest rolling 60 seconds. This uses local receipt time, not Yahoo's possibly delayed market-event timestamp.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "ticker_data")
  |> range(start: -1m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ticker_ingest" and r._field == "count")
  |> group()
  |> count()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _time: now(), _field: "received_ticks_per_minute"}))

panels.title: Received ticks per minute
panels.description: One-minute ingestion counts using collector receipt time. Empty minutes are shown as zero; Yahoo event timestamps may be older for delayed exchanges.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "ticker_data")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ticker_ingest" and r._field == "count")
  |> group()
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: count, createEmpty: true)
  |> fill(value: 0)

panels.title: Time since last tick
panels.description: Scrollable age table for the latest Yahoo timestamp per observed symbol in the selected range. Closed markets naturally become stale; symbols without a tick in range have no row.

  else if id == "EURUSD=X" then "EURUSD=X · Global FX"

  else if id == "SAP.DE" then "SAP.DE · Germany"
  else if id == "HSBA.L" then "HSBA.L · United Kingdom"
  else if id == "AAPL" then "AAPL · United States"
  else if id == "NVDA" then "NVDA · United States"
  else if id == "SHOP.TO" then "SHOP.TO · Canada"
  else if id == "VALE3.SA" then "VALE3.SA · Brazil"
  else id

from(bucket: "ticker_data")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ticker")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => symbolLabel(id: r.id) =~ /^${symbol:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "price")
  |> group(columns: ["id"])
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({Symbol: symbolLabel(id: r.id), Age: float(v: uint(v: now()) - uint(v: r._time)) / 1000000000.0}))
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["Symbol"])

  else if id == "0700.HK" then "0700.HK · Hong Kong"
  else if id == "D05.SI" then "D05.SI · Singapore"
  else if id == "RELIANCE.NS" then "RELIANCE.NS · India"
  else if id == "EMAAR.AE" then "EMAAR.AE · Dubai (UAE)"
  else if id == "NPN.JO" then "NPN.JO · South Africa"
  else if id == "SAP.DE" then "SAP.DE · Germany"
  else if id == "HSBA.L" then "HSBA.L · United Kingdom"
  else if id == "AAPL" then "AAPL · United States"
  else if id == "NVDA" then "NVDA · United States"
  else if id == "SHOP.TO" then "SHOP.TO · Canada"
  else if id == "VALE3.SA" then "VALE3.SA · Brazil"
  else id

sessionInfo = (id) =>
  if id == "BTC-USD" then "BTC-USD · Global · Bitcoin · trades 24/7 UTC"
  else if id == "EURUSD=X" then "EURUSD=X · Global FX · EUR/USD · trades nearly 24 hours Sunday–Friday UTC; the weekly boundary shifts with US DST"
  else if id == "GC=F" then "GC=F · United States (COMEX) · gold futures · UTC 22:00–21:00 during CDT / 23:00–22:00 during CST, with a one-hour daily break"
  else if id == "FPH.NZ" then "FPH.NZ · New Zealand (NZX) · Fisher & Paykel Healthcare · regular session UTC 21:00 (previous day)–03:45 during NZDT / 22:00 (previous day)–04:45 during NZST"
  else if id == "BHP.AX" then "BHP.AX · Australia (ASX) · BHP · regular session UTC 23:00 (previous day)–05:00 during AEDT / 00:00–06:00 during AEST"
  else if id == "7203.T" then "7203.T · Japan (Tokyo) · Toyota · regular sessions UTC 00:00–02:30 and 03:30–06:30"
  else if id == "0700.HK" then "0700.HK · Hong Kong · Tencent · regular sessions UTC 01:30–04:00 and 05:00–08:00"
  else if id == "D05.SI" then "D05.SI · Singapore · DBS Group · regular sessions UTC 01:00–04:00 and 05:00–09:00"
  else if id == "RELIANCE.NS" then "RELIANCE.NS · India · Reliance Industries · regular session UTC 03:45–10:00"
  else if id == "EMAAR.AE" then "EMAAR.AE · Dubai (UAE) · Emaar Properties · regular session UTC 06:00–11:00"
  else if id == "NPN.JO" then "NPN.JO · South Africa · Naspers · regular session UTC 07:00–15:00"
  else if id == "SAP.DE" then "SAP.DE · Germany (Xetra) · SAP · regular session UTC 07:00–15:30 during CEST / 08:00–16:30 during CET"
  else if id == "HSBA.L" then "HSBA.L · United Kingdom (London) · HSBC · regular session UTC 07:00–15:30 during BST / 08:00–16:30 during GMT"
  else if id == "AAPL" then "AAPL · United States (Nasdaq) · Apple · regular session UTC 13:30–20:00 during EDT / 14:30–21:00 during EST"
  else if id == "NVDA" then "NVDA · United States (Nasdaq) · NVIDIA · regular session UTC 13:30–20:00 during EDT / 14:30–21:00 during EST"
  else if id == "SHOP.TO" then "SHOP.TO · Canada (Toronto) · Shopify · regular session UTC 13:30–20:00 during EDT / 14:30–21:00 during EST"
  else if id == "VALE3.SA" then "VALE3.SA · Brazil (São Paulo) · Vale · regular session UTC 13:00–20:00"
  else id + " · Country, instrument and regular-session metadata unavailable"

defaults = array.from(rows: [{_value: "BTC-USD"}, {_value: "EURUSD=X"}, {_value: "GC=F"}, {_value: "FPH.NZ"}, {_value: "BHP.AX"}, {_value: "7203.T"}, {_value: "0700.HK"}, {_value: "D05.SI"}, {_value: "RELIANCE.NS"}, {_value: "EMAAR.AE"}, {_value: "NPN.JO"}, {_value: "SAP.DE"}, {_value: "HSBA.L"}, {_value: "AAPL"}, {_value: "NVDA"}, {_value: "SHOP.TO"}, {_value: "VALE3.SA"}])

observed = from(bucket: "ticker_data")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ticker" and r._field == "price")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: r.id}))
  |> group()
  |> distinct()

union(tables: [defaults, observed])
  |> group()
  |> distinct()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: symbolLabel(id: r._value) + "|" + sessionInfo(id: r._value)}))
